basic_info.description: Welcome to the 36th Ave Duplex, a fabulous and flexible opportunity to own a two-unit building - to be delivered vacant - in San Francisco's beloved Sunset neighborhood. Lovingly owned and stewarded for decades, this duplex is ideal for savvy owner-occupiers, multi-generational households, house hackers, or investors. Both units offer 2 bedrooms and 1 bathroom, with well-appointed layouts, great natural light, and timeless charm. At street level, a spacious garage provides ample storage and parking. The backyard offers garden space or a blank canvas for outdoor living. In every direction, enjoy the best of the Sunset's cafs, markets, shops, restaurants, and playgrounds  plus easy access to Golden Gate Park and Ocean Beach. Local gems abound! Commuting is a breeze with nearby Muni lines, Sunset Boulevard, and the Great Highway. This is a rare chance to own a duplex in one of San Francisco's most vibrant coastal neighborhoods  full of potential and ready for its next chapter.
